paragraphs.text: The Endless Sea is a body of water off the northern Terisian Isles .

The Endless Sea is the part of the Dominarian ocean that lies north of the Terisian Isles (former Terisiare ). The Endless Sea borders the northern shores of Gulmany , specifically Efuan Pincar , and onto the shores of the Balduvian Steppes . It connects to the Ilesemare Sea in the west, the Sea of Laments in the south, and the Videnthian Sea in the east.

The Endless Sea bordered the northern coasts of Terisiare before that continent was split into smaller islands. During the Brothers' War , the sea ran along from the Colekgan Mountains , past Ronom Glacier to the Malpiri Plains . During the Dark Age , the Endless Sea formed icebergs, and whole ice sheets formed in the northernmost parts. During the Ice Age , the ice floes coalesced into massive ice caps, with glacial spurs running onto the continent itself.

In both the Arena novel and in Shattered Chains , it is mentioned that the backcountry of Gish borders the Endless Sea to the south, which corresponds to the location of the Honeyed Sea , which is in turn mentioned by name in the Whispering Woods novel. Since southern Aerona is nowhere near northern Terisiare 's Endless Sea, there are either two Endless Seas on Dominaria , or this must be considered a mistake or a retcon.
